info.title: Reaya+ API
info.description: Reaya+ backend API. Responses use `{ data, meta? }`; errors use `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`. Messages are Arabic (`Accept-Language: ar`).

full_text.example: 15 شارع عباس العقاد، الدور 4، شقة 12، مدينة نصر، القاهرة

travel_fee.description: Added to home visits in the searched area (piastres)

get.summary: Readiness for load balancers / uptime monitors: 200 when MongoDB and Redis answer within 2 s, otherwise 503
Scheduled jobs (booking deadlines, reminders, suspension lifts, document check): 200 when each ran recently, 503 when one has gone silent — point an alert at it

post.summary: Send a login code by SMS. Limits: 1/min and 3/10 min per phone, 10/hour per IP.
Verify the code: a session for existing users, a registration token for new numbers
Finish sign-up. Authorization: Bearer <registration_token> (from /auth/otp/verify)
Exchange a refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once — never refresh in parallel.
End this session (and unregister the device push token if given)
Send a code to the new phone number
Confirm the code and switch the account to the new number

patch.summary: Update name, email, gender, date of birth, language

delete.summary: Close the account (sessions end now; data retained per the retention policy)

post.summary: Register or refresh this device’s FCM token
Upload a profile photo (JPG or PNG, max 10 MB); replaces the previous one

get.summary: Startup config: min app versions, support/emergency numbers, policies, feature flags
Active areas of a governorate (address form picker)
Search active areas (provider coverage multi-select). Tolerates Arabic spelling variants.

post.summary: Create a governorate
Create an area

patch.summary: Update / activate / deactivate an area, or set its travel-fee cap

get.summary: Active services, optionally filtered by category / provider type
Doctor specialties — for the doctor profile and the search filter

post.summary: Create a service category

patch.summary: Update / activate / deactivate a service category

delete.summary: Delete an empty service category (409 while it still has services)

post.summary: Create a service

patch.summary: Update a service (incl. min/max price bounds)

post.summary: Upload a private file (max 10 MB; JPG, PNG or PDF — avatars images only). Returns a temporary `file_key` to attach with the relevant endpoint; unattached files are removed after a day.
Add an address (text only — coordinates are rejected). The first one becomes the default.

delete.summary: Delete an address (deleting the default promotes the newest remaining one)

post.summary: Make this the default address
Add a family member

patch.summary: Update a profile (the "self" relation can’t change)

post.summary: Attach a file uploaded via POST /uploads (purpose: medical_document)

delete.summary: Delete a medical document and its file

get.summary: Reports written by providers after visits, newest first (audited)
Report details: vitals, procedures, recommendations, attachments (10-minute signed URLs; audited)

post.summary: Add a chronic condition
Add a medication
Add an allergy

patch.summary: Update profile. Type / license / syndicate number are locked while under review or once approved.

post.summary: Attach a file uploaded via POST /uploads (purpose: provider_document). Replaces the previous one of a required type.

delete.summary: Remove a document (not one the admin approved)

post.summary: Submit for admin review (draft / changes_requested / rejected → pending). 422 lists missing onboarding items.

get.summary: Verification status, admin message / rejection reason, per-document results
Areas I cover, with travel fees

put.summary: Replace covered areas (chosen from GET /areas — no map or radius). Independent providers only.
Replace services and prices (piastres, within admin bounds). Independent providers only.
Replace the weekly schedule (no overlapping slots per day; split overnight shifts across days)

post.summary: Add time off

patch.summary: Toggle accepting bookings (403 PROVIDER_NOT_VERIFIED unless approved)

get.summary: Verification queue, oldest submission first (organizations: Phase 3)
Full submission with signed document URLs, coverage, services and checklist

post.summary: Approve (pending documents are accepted with it; 409 while any document is "not matching")
Send back for changes; the listed documents must be re-uploaded
Reject (the provider can fix and resubmit)
Mark one document matching / not matching, optionally setting its expiry

get.summary: Search providers by service and area (never distance). Approved, accepting, active accounts only. `date` (+ optional `time`) keeps only providers with a free slot then.

schema.description: From the selected address — matching is by area only

parameters.description: From the selected address — matching is by area only
parameters.name: area_id

get.summary: Provider reviews, newest first (reviewer shown by first name + initial)
Bookable slots on a Cairo date (every 30 min, ≥ 60 min ahead, ≤ 60 days out)

post.summary: Price breakdown + a quote token that guarantees it for 10 minutes
Book from a quote (cash only in Phase 1). 409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE if the time was just taken.

get.summary: My bookings — upcoming (soonest first) or past (latest first)
Booking details + status timeline (manual status updates — no location tracking)

post.summary: Cancel (free while pending, and until the cancellation window before the visit)
New time with the same provider — goes back to pending until they accept
Same service, provider, patient and address at a new time — returns a quote
Rate a completed visit — once per booking (409 ALREADY_REVIEWED)
Report a problem with a completed visit or a recorded no-show, within the dispute window (setting dispute_window_hours). The booking becomes "disputed".

get.summary: Dashboard: today's visits, pending requests, open offers, today's earnings
Details. Patient, phone, address and notes only once accepted; medical summary only during the visit + 7 days (audited).

post.summary: Accept a direct request (before the response deadline)
Decline a direct request
Manual "on my way" (no location is collected)
Start the visit (records whether it was on time)
End the visit
Patient not available (from the booked time on)
Cancel an accepted visit
Confirm the cash was received

get.summary: Open requests offered to several providers — first to accept wins

post.summary: Accept an offer — 409 OFFER_TAKEN if someone accepted first
Decline an offer
Visit report (from the start of the visit) — added to the patient's medical record; the patient is notified

patch.summary: Correct the report — within 24 hours of submitting it

post.summary: Mark notifications read: `{ "ids": [...] }` or `{ "all": true }`

get.summary: Notification preferences (turning one off silences its push; the in-app list keeps everything)
KPIs (bookings today, 30-day GMV / revenue, active providers, pending verifications, open disputes), 14-day chart, today by status, top areas, recent activity
Needs attention: requests nobody took (last 24 h), open disputes, documents expired or expiring within 30 days
All platform settings (defaults merged with admin overrides)

put.summary: Change some settings — all-or-nothing; unknown keys / bad values → 422 per key

get.summary: Users, newest first. `search` matches name or phone.

post.summary: Suspend (duration_days: null = until lifted). Sessions end, a provider stops taking bookings, and their active bookings are cancelled (the other side is notified).
Record a warning (optionally tied to a booking / dispute / review) and notify the user
Lift the suspension

get.summary: Suspensions, warnings, disputes and audit trail

patch.summary: Suspend the listing (approved → suspended: stops bookings, cancels active ones) or restore it, and/or set the admin message

post.summary: Create an admin account (they sign in with phone + OTP)

patch.summary: Disable / re-enable another admin (not yourself, not the last active one). Sub-roles: TBD.

get.summary: Bookings, latest visit first. `search` matches the reference code.
Full details + status history + offers (payments: Phase 2)

post.summary: Force cancel / no-show / complete where the state machine allows it (completing records the commission). Disputes: patient flow; providers: /reassign.
Give a pending / accepted booking to another approved provider who offers the service and is free then; it becomes accepted

get.summary: Dispute details with signed attachment URLs

post.summary: Resolve: refund (defaults to the booking total) / partial refund / no action — recorded only until card payments (Phase 2); optionally warn or suspend the provider and message each side

get.summary: Reviews, newest first. `flagged=true`: comments that look like they contain contact details.

patch.summary: Hide / show, or mask contact details in the comment (the original is kept). Clears the flag.
